You don't have to be right most of the time.

Kevin Trudeau explains that building wealth doesn't mean being right a hundred percent of the time. Some people assume 51% is the bar. His answer is no. All you have to do is be right once.

He says luck works the same way. You only need to tilt things in your favor a little. That inch, that centimeter, can make the difference.

What would you try if you only had to be right once?
